basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Portland, Oregon, with a newfound passion for home gardening and cannabis cultivation. I spend my days coding and my evenings researching and tending to my small grow operation in my backyard. I enjoy experimenting with different strains and sharing my experiences with others. When I'm not working or gardening, you can find me playing tabletop games with friends or exploring the local food scene. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As someone who has always been interested in technology, I have a strong foundation in computer science, which I pursued during my college years. My interest in cannabis cultivation began as a personal project to explore sustainable living and self-sufficiency. I've learned through a combination of online courses and forums, particularly engaging with the microgrowery community on Reddit.
